title: QA Analyst - Intern
description: Job Description: Intern: QA Analyst About Us: UpEnergy is the leading developer of anti-poverty climate impact projects in Africa. We accelerate decarbonization and while delivering long-term health and income benefits in local communities. We provide life-improving clean technologies and carbon reduction and capture projects that protect the local environment, deliver health benefits and cleaner air, and reduce poverty through financial savings and employment. Our project sustainably benefits and enables people to live better lives within more climate resilient communities. To date, UpEnergy has built over 95 emission reduction projects, impacted over 4 million lives, and reduced over 3 million tons of CO2 Emissions across 10 countries. All UpEnergy’s work is characterized by respect for the people we serve, rigorous measurement, deep local knowledge and established teams on the ground to ensure the highest impact and results. We do all this through our commitment to drive long-term business growth through technical innovation, close customer engagement and increased data-driven decision making. The UpEnergy team continues to grow, across multiple African countries, from 20 to over 170+ full time team members in the past two years, reflecting the growth of the company for which we now seek incredible, like-minded talent who are excited to join us in delivering even more impact. Learn more here: UpEnergy Group Why This Role As Carbon Data & QC Ops grows in scale and complexity — more markets, more monthly cycles, more deliverables going to field teams, leadership, auditors and registries — quality and consistency checks need a dedicated owner. This role builds that layer: a second pair of eyes across the team's output before it ships, so reliability doesn't depend on one person catching everything alone. The role starts high-level — general quality assurance across data, forms, reports and tools. As trust and familiarity build, scope naturally grows into broader day-to-day operational support. Role Summary Own quality assurance across the team's deliverables — data, forms, reports, dashboards, and working tools — catching errors early and keeping output reliable and consistent before it goes out. Key Responsibilities Quality review: check deliverables — data outputs, forms, reports, dashboards — for accuracy and consistency before they ship. Source verification: spot-check numbers and records against source data. Review logging: keep a simple, current log of what was checked and what was found — no review without a record. Early escalation: flag anything uncertain the same day rather than guess or sit on it. Day-to-day support: pick up broader operational and data tasks as capacity and trust grow — this role is designed to expand, not stay fixed. Candidate Profile Must-Haves High attention to detail; methodical and comfortable with repetitive, precision-dependent work. Clear written communication — much of the work is asynchronous review and reporting. Proactive problem-solver — surfaces issues with a proposed fix, not just a flag. Reliable and self-directed; this role runs on a checklist and a log, not close supervision. Nice-to-Haves (bonus, not gating) Familiarity with survey/data-collection tools (e.g. XLSForm, SurveyCTO, ODK, KoboToolbox). Basic SQL and/or Python — enough to spot-check a query or re-run a script and read its output. Prior exposure to carbon markets, M&E, or program data — shortens ramp-up, not required. Explicitly Not Required Not a developer hire — no new feature-building or software-engineering expected. No prior carbon-credit or MRV expertise required. What You'll Gain Direct, hands-on mentorship from the Senior Data Analyst on real carbon-market data and operations — not shadow work, actual production deliverables. Broad exposure across data, forms, reporting and tooling — a strong general foundation, not a narrow niche. Growing ownership — the role expands as trust builds, not a role capped at one task forever. A structured ramp-up with regular feedback, not thrown in blind. Decision Rights Tier What it covers Flags & logs — no ask needed Any discrepancy found during review, however small. Decides independently Obvious fixes (typos, formatting); re-running a check after correcting an input error. Never their call What ships externally; final sign-off on anything going to leadership, auditors or registries — that stays with Shoaib. Success — First 90 Days Deliverables going out to field teams or leadership have an independent check behind them. A current, complete review log exists and reflects real work — no gaps. The role has picked up at least one recurring day-to-day task beyond pure review. Practical Details Reports to: Shoaib Ahmed Noorani, Senior Data Analyst, Carbon Data & QC Ops. Engagement: Full-time preferred; initial 3-month trial with extension based on performance. Location: In Office (Bangalore) Why Join Us? Not your average 9-to-5 UpEnergy encourages teamwork, creativity, and we’re not afraid to get our hands dirty. We stay close to our market, understand our customers, and have a lot of fun while doing our work! If you’re looking for a conventional 9-to-5, you’d be missing out on our adventures! Opportunity to do things in a new way As one of the largest compliance credit issuer in Africa, we need to be constantly improving and rethinking our way of work. This means endless opportunities for a self-starter to initiate new ways of doing things or experimenting ways to help us improve. Personal and Career Growth Wouldn’t it be a pity to spend so much time working but not growing and learning? At UpEnergy we value both personal and professional growth, and we want to grow as a team. From classroom training to coffee chats to performance review, we want to support every team member to grow into the best version they can. Create Lasting Impact Our clean energy products bring positive impact to both our planet earth and for the low-income communities we work in. We don’t just focus on sales – we follow up and truly understand our customers to make sure that they continue to benefit from our products. Your work will create much longer-lasting impact than what you can see! Compensation: The Intern will receive a stipend. Internship Duration: 6 months Start date & Location: The position is based in Chennai, India. We are looking for the right candidate to start as soon as possible.

title: Software Testing Intern
description: Internship Opportunity – Software Testing Intern Company: Popkey Private Limited Brand: Popkey Smart Lockers Location: Chennai Duration: 3 Months Monthly Stipend: ₹7,000 About Popkey Popkey is an IoT-based smart locker solutions company offering innovative, technology-driven storage solutions. Our products integrate hardware, software, web applications and mobile applications to deliver seamless, secure and keyless locker experiences. Role Overview We are looking for enthusiastic, detail-oriented and passionate Software Testing Interns to join our technology team. The selected candidates will gain hands-on experience in testing web applications, backend systems and Android mobile applications, ensuring the functionality, performance, usability and reliability of our products. Roles & Responsibilities1. Front-End Testing Test web application interfaces for functionality and usability. Verify buttons, forms, menus, dashboards and user workflows. Identify UI issues, layout inconsistencies and navigation errors. Perform cross-browser and responsive testing. 2. Back-End Testing Test backend functionalities and business logic. Verify API responses, data flow and database operations. Validate user authentication, access permissions and system workflows. Identify and document backend errors and inconsistencies. 3. Mobile Application Testing Test Android mobile applications for functionality and usability. Verify login, registration, booking and locker access workflows. Test compatibility across different devices and screen sizes. Identify bugs, application crashes, performance issues and navigation errors. 4. Bug Reporting & Documentation Identify, record and report software bugs. Prepare test cases and test execution reports. Perform regression testing after bug fixes. Coordinate with developers to verify issue resolution. Eligibility & Skills Students or freshers from Computer Science, IT, BCA, MCA, B.Sc. Computer Science or related backgrounds. Basic understanding of software testing concepts. Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, APIs or SQL will be an advantage. Familiarity with Postman, browser developer tools or testing tools is preferred. Good analytical, problem-solving and communication skills. Willingness to learn and work on real-time technology projects. What You Will Gain Hands-on experience in real-world software testing. Exposure to front-end, backend and Android application testing. Practical knowledge of API testing and database validation. Experience working with IoT-based smart locker technology. Opportunity to work closely with experienced developers. Practical exposure to real-time product development and testing. Internship Details Duration: 3 Months Stipend: ₹7,000 per month Location: Chennai Employment Opportunity: Performance-based opportunity for full-time employment upon successful completion of the internship. Join Popkey and gain hands-on experience in building and testing next-generation IoT technology solutions! Job Types: Full-time, Internship Pay: ₹7,000.00 - ₹8,000.00 per month Work Location: In person

title: Business Analyst Internship with employment as BA Trainee
company: Bow and Baan Technology Solutions pvt Ltd
description: Job Overview We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Business Analyst intern to join our dynamic team. As an intern, you will work closely with stakeholders across the organization and learn to analyze business needs, translating them into actionable requirements, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver effective solutions. The Business Analyst intern will learn and contribute to the success of our projects by leveraging analytical skills, industry knowledge, interpersonal skills and excellent communication abilities. Responsibilities Responsibilities Gather and document business requirements from stakeholders. Translate requirements into functional specifications for development teams. Collaborate with product managers and developers to refine user stories and acceptance criteria. Conduct gap analysis and propose solutions aligned with business goals. Support UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and ensure deliverables meet quality standards. Act as liaison between clients and technical teams to ensure clear communication. Create BRDs (Business Requirement Documents), FRDs (Functional Requirement Documents), Prototypes, and process flows. Develop test cases and assist in system integration testing. Work closely with Dev, QA teams to validate solutions against client expectations. Provide ongoing support for change requests and enhancements. Use tools such as SQL, Python, Excel, and BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Opensource tools) to automate data tasks. Write scripts to automate data cleaning, reporting, and other routine analysis tasks. Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and analytics teams. Participate in team meetings, code reviews, and brainstorming sessions. Document methodologies, findings, and project outcomes clearly and concisely. Stay current on industry trends in AI, data analytics, and machine learning. Take initiative to explore new tools, methods, and AI applications in data analysis. Receive mentorship and training to grow technical and analytical skills. Collaborate with stakeholders to understand needs, objectives, and challenges. MS office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)/ G suite proficiency. Experience in coding will be an added advantage. Candidates, who do not have any software education, please do not apply Apply SDLC methodologies for effective project planning and execution. Analyze business processes, systems, and data to identify improvement opportunities and create BRDs. Proficient in creating clear and comprehensive documentation. Understand and work on data models, process flows, and data mappings. Work closely with technical teams to design and validate solutions. Will learn skills like flow charts, detailed documentations such as BRD, FRD. Facilitate effective communication between business and technical teams. Familiarity with relevant project management tools, software tools and technologies. Maintain regular communication with project stakeholders, providing updates on progress, risks, and issues. Must track project timelines, milestones, and deliverables, ensuring projects stay on schedule. Present findings, progress updates, and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences. Define and execute test plans, collaborating to ensure high-quality solutions. Support project planning, estimation, and resource allocation, monitoring progress and identifying risks Skills MS office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)/ G suite, Figma proficiency. Experience in coding will be an added advantage. Possessing proficiency in multiple languages, both spoken and written, constitutes a valuable advantage. Candidates, who do not have any software education, please do not apply Strong knowledge of SDLC, Agile methodologies, and Jira/Confluence. Excellent communication and analytical skills. Proficiency in SQL, Excel, and BI tools (Power BI/Tableau). Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills. Strong documentation and presentation skills. Experience with tools like AI studio, , Figma, MS Visio, Lucidchart, and project management platforms. Perks and Benefits: Internship Certificate Shortlisted will be considered for full time employment Job Types: Full-time, Internship Pay: From ₹180,000.00 per year Benefits: Health insurance Ability to commute/relocate: Ashok Nagar, Chennai, Tamil Nadu: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred) Education: Master's (Preferred) Work Location: In person

title: Software Engineer Intern
description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: At PayPal, we’re literally reinventing how the world pays and gets paid. We understand that it’s about people. We connect individuals to let them shop, get paid, donate and send money using today’s technology with the confidence that comes from the security and control PayPal enables. Are you ready to help us change the world? The world’s leading payments company, PayPal, brings together a family of brands that are revolutionizing the way people move money. At PayPal you will be immersed in an amazing community with a vibrant culture that thrives on innovation, collaboration, inclusion and wellness. Job Description: Meet our team: Software Engineer at PayPal develop innovative solutions and high-quality products that touch millions of people every day around the globe. Our engineers solve some of the most complex technical problems in the world of connected payments across all business units, including PayPal, Braintree, Venmo, Paydiant and others. We are looking for the highest levels of technical talent and programming skills, as well as a keen desire to deeply understand our products and services to push our technology forward with respect to functionality, performance, reliability, and scalability. Your way to impact: As a Software Engineering Intern, you’ll work alongside the best and the brightest engineering talent in the industry. We have opportunities in a wide range of areas including development, design, search, platform, test, quality, big data, front end and back end. As a core participant of your team, you’ll estimate engineering efforts, design your changes, implement and test your changes, push to live, and triage production issues. You need to be dynamic, collaborative, and curious as we build new experiences, improve existing products, and develop distributed systems powering the world’s largest e-commerce and payments websites at a scale only a few companies can match. Your day-to-day: Code high-volume and scalable software (front-end and/or back-end focused). This may include creating web applications using React/Node, creating back-end services using Java, SQL, ReST and/or building and developing new user-facing experiences Partner closely with cross functional teams in design, product and other business units What do you need to bring: Strong applied experience. You’ve built, broken, and rebuilt software applications. We’re looking for creative thinkers who also know how to create real-world products. Working knowledge of web technologies (such as HTTP, HTML/DOM, JavaScript, CSS, AJAX) Familiarity with any or multiple of the following: Node.js applications, Java, C++. Python Understanding of concepts like Web Services, SOA, REST APIs A constant desire to grow, learn, and explore new things University Graduate Position Information and Requirements: This is a university intern position. title: Associate Software Engineer Intern - YMS
description: Job Description About the Role Kaleris builds Yard Management Systems (YMS) that control and optimize the movement of goods throughout the supply chain — across gates, yards, docks, and drivers. We are actively expanding our YMS platform with new automation capabilities including gate intelligence, real-time yard visibility, and driver self-service workflows. As an intern on this team, you'll contribute to real engineering problems on a live product. You'll be assigned to one or more focus areas based on team needs and your own strengths — which may shift during the internship as priorities evolve. You should be comfortable with ambiguity and self-directed enough to ramp up on a new area with limited hand-holding. What You May Work On Your work will fall within either of the following areas, depending on where the team needs you most: Gate Automation & Computer Vision (Research & Prototype) Explore and prototype computer vision and OCR approaches for automated detection of truck and trailer data at yard gates — trailer numbers, license plates, cab numbers, USDOT numbers, and seal presence Build and evaluate training data pipelines using publicly available datasets and real-world gate imagery Benchmark detection accuracy and document what is achievable in-house vs. what would require significant investment Assess feasibility of running detection models on edge hardware (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson or equivalent) YMS Platform Feature Development Work on backend features within the Kaleris YMS platform — contributing to gate workflow logic, shipment management, dock door assignments, or yard inventory tracking Write clean, testable code and participate in code reviews Help reduce manual data entry pain points through automation and smarter integrations Required What You Bring Currently pursuing a B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field (final or pre-final year) Solid programming fundamentals in at least one language — Python, Java, or similar Any hands-on project or coursework involving computer vision, OCR, or machine learning (academic, personal, or Kaggle — show us the code) Familiarity with PyTorch or TensorFlow, and Python data libraries (OpenCV, NumPy) Ability to pick up new technologies independently — you won't have a dedicated senior in every focus area Clear written communication — you'll need to document your work and surface blockers clearly Genuine curiosity about how software solves real operational problems Good To Have Web development experience — frontend or backend Ruby on Rails familiarity — our YMS platform has Rails components; any Rails or web backend experience is a strong plus Exposure to REST APIs, event-driven systems, or database design Interest in logistics, yard/warehouse operations, or supply chain technology What You'll Get Exposure to a real, production YMS platform used by major logistics operators Ownership of a meaningful deliverable — not a sandbox exercise Flexibility to contribute across different areas of the product based on where you add the most value Kaleris is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Engineering Intern – Transport Analytics
description: Job Description Role Summary & Core Objective The Transport Analytics team serves as the backbone data warehouse ecosystem powering our suite of inland transport products. We bridge complex supply chain logistics with high-performance data systems to solve real-world operational challenges. We are seeking a high-octane Engineering Intern who combines strong core software engineering fundamentals with a curiosity for modern AI paradigms to drive quantifiable business outcomes: revenue growth, cost reduction, or elevated customer satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Full-Stack & API Development: Design, build, and maintain lightweight web applications and RESTful APIs that interface directly with our analytics database ecosystem. Data & Analytics Integration: Query, transform, and leverage data warehouse pipelines to feed user-facing analytical tools and internal operational dashboards. AI & Agentic Experimentation: Assist in prototyping modern AI workflows—exploring Agentic AI frameworks, LLM integrations, and intelligent automation to solve transport analytics challenges. Cross-Functional Problem Solving: Work closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate complex business problems into reliable, efficient engineering solutions. Rapid Prototyping: Adapt quickly to changing product needs, delivering functional proof-of-concepts (PoCs) that can be validated directly with end-users. Minimum Qualifications Qualifications & Skill Requirements Education: Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Polyglot Programming: Solid foundational knowledge and hands-on project experience in both Python and Java. Database & Web Fundamentals: Practical understanding of relational database systems (SQL/NoSQL) and experience building web applications connected via backend DB APIs. Modern AI Awareness: Familiarity with Generative AI concepts, LLM application architectures, or emerging Agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or tool-use patterns). Problem-Solving Mindset: A structured, analytical approach to troubleshooting and breaking down ambiguous business problems into clear technical components. Preferred Qualifications Logistics & Data Pipelines: Prior internship, open-source contribution, or academic project experience involving data warehousing, ETL pipelines. Cloud & DevOps Tools: Basic understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS /Azure) and containerization tools like Docker. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical business partners. What Success Looks Like (KPIs & Impact) During your internship, success will be measured by your ability to deliver end-to-end engineering solutions that drive tangible output across at least one of these core business pillars: Cost Reduction: Automating inefficient manual workflows or optimizing query performance to cut cloud infrastructure and operational overhead. Revenue Growth: Building feature prototypes or analytics tools that unlock new customer capabilities or identify upsell opportunities across transport products. Customer Satisfaction (CSAT): Resolving latency bottlenecks and improving data visibility for transport stakeholders to deliver a seamless user experience. Why Join Us? High Ownership & Impact: Work on live data infrastructure and customer-impacting products rather than isolated side projects. Mentorship & Growth: Collaborate directly with senior data engineers, software architects, and technical product managers who are invested in your career. Cutting-Edge Tech Stack: Get hands-on exposure at the intersection of enterprise data warehouses, full-stack web development, and next-gen AI frameworks. Kaleris is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Junior Salesforce Developer
description: About Us dotSolved, headquartered in Silicon Valley USA, is a leading global provider of business process automation, modern application engineering, and cloud infrastructure services. dotSolved focuses on enabling digital transformations for small, medium, and large enterprises, in the following industries (but not limited to): High technology, Energy, Manufacturing, Financial Services, Media & Entertainment, Communications, Retail, Healthcare, and Education. dotSolved drives digital transformations for enterprises by defining, automating, and optimizing complex business processes for the digital era and engineering modern, data & analytic driven, applications that deliver intended business value. With hundreds of successful implementations and experience in Big Data, ERP, and Supply Chain, dotSolved can guarantee the creation of measurable business value from project engagements leading to accelerated business growth and profitability for customers. Job Description Position: Junior SalesForce Developer Shift Timing: 3.00AM - 12.00PM PST (US Pacific Time) Location: Chennai/Bangalore - Onsite About the role: We are looking for a Junior Salesforce Developer with 1–2 years of experience to join our Salesforce development team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Salesforce development, Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL/SOSL, and Salesforce configuration. You will work closely with senior developers, Salesforce administrators, functional consultants, and business stakeholders to develop, customize, test, and support Salesforce applications. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, and SOQL/SOSL. Build custom Salesforce functionality based on business and technical requirements. Develop Apex Classes, Triggers, Batch Apex, Scheduled Apex, and asynchronous processes as required. Create and enhance Lightning Web Components and Lightning pages. Work with Salesforce objects, fields, relationships, validation rules, flows, and other platform features. Integrate Salesforce with external applications using REST/SOAP APIs and other integration mechanisms. Write efficient and optimized SOQL queries and Apex code while following Salesforce governor limits. Participate in unit testing, debugging, deployment, and production support. title: Associate Security Engineer
description: Job Summary Coupas Security Engineers keep our enterprise, product, platform, and customer data safe. As an Associate Security Engineer, youll build your foundation in cloud, application, and infrastructure security by contributing to real, well-scoped engineering work alongside experienced teammates. Youll partner with Engineering, IT, and Compliance, learn how we build durable, automated security tooling instead of one-off fixes, and grow your root-cause analysis skills with mentorship and regular feedback. This is a role for someone early in their security career who wants hands-on ownership of growing scope - with the support to get there. Responsibilities Support the design and implementation of multi-cloud security controls - VPC segmentation, security groups/NACLs, and least-privilege IAM policies - on well-scoped tasks, with guidance from senior engineers. Build familiarity with permission boundaries and Organizations/SCPs along the way. Contribute to policy as code and IaC security guardrails in CI/CD pipelines: write and tune rules, reduce false positives, and help keep pre-merge and pre-deploy checks reliable. Assist in hardening containerized workloads and Kubernetes clusters, including image scanning, admission control, pod security standards, and network policies. Triage vulnerability findings from application packages, container images, and third-party dependencies. Gather context on exploitability and business impact, and escalate complex or ambiguous findings to senior teammates. Help the Risk Compliance team gather technical evidence for audit frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, FedRAMP), and learn what auditable evidence looks like. Write and maintain scripts and small automations that make security work faster and more repeatable. Learn from mentors through pairing, design reviews, and feedback on your remediation plans. Document what you learn and help improve runbooks. Support the secure design, deployment, and operational monitoring of enterprise AI systems, models, and agentic workflows. Help design and develop internal AI-driven security tools, automation scripts, and guardrails to improve threat detection and vulnerability remediation. Requirements 0-2 years of experience in security, cloud, DevOps, IT, or software engineering. Internships, co-ops, research, and hands-on personal or lab projects count. Foundational knowledge of cloud security concepts (AWS, GCP, or Azure) - IAM, networking, and common misconfigurations - gained through work, coursework, labs, or certifications. Working scripting skills in Python, Bash, or JavaScript, and interest in building or extending internal security tooling. Familiarity with vulnerability scanning concepts (dependency and container scanning). Exposure to CI/CD pipelines is a plus. Basic awareness of common compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, FedRAMP) and a willingness to learn how they translate into technical controls. Curiosity and a habit of asking why - you want to understand the cause of a vulnerability, not just what the scanner reported. Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort asking questions, asking for help, and escalating early. Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (bootcamps, military, self-directed learning, or similar). Entry-level certifications are a plus: Security+, ISC2 CC, AWS Cloud Practitioner or AWS/GCP/Azure security certifications. Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source.
